science.title: Why collagen, and why hydrolyzed
science.text: Collagen is the most abundant protein in your body — the scaffolding of your skin, hair, nails, joints and bones. From your mid-twenties you make less of it each year. 'Hydrolyzed' means the collagen is broken into small peptides your body absorbs easily, so it can use the building blocks where they're needed. Ours is grass-fed and flavoured with real cocoa, with 20 g of collagen and 18 g of protein per serving.
